items.html: And this Yesod, which is the palate of the mouth of Arich Anpin, couples (mizdaveg) with the throat, which is the Malchut of this brain, called Bina, as mentioned. And this coupling is called kisses (Neshikin). And through this coupling, Aba veIma were corrected there, in the throat of Arich Anpin, as was said.
